items.html: Now the general rule of the matter is found: all the aspects that ZA has until the time of nursing — which is the aspect of the six extremities in each and every edge of his seven — all of them are called the aspect of Elokim. But the first three in each edge of his lower Ze'ir Anpin edges, and likewise all the upper first three of the head of ZA — each one is included of ten Sefirot. And all this is called the mochin of Gadlut, and all of them are the aspect of HVYH names. And this is both in the aspect of MaH and in the aspect of BaN, both in ZA and in the Nukva. And you will find that ZA divides into two aspects: one is called the mochin of ZA, and one is called the body of the six extremities; and the body is his six extremities, each one included of six extremities alone; and the mochin are the first three in his head, each one included of ten Sefirot; and likewise the first three in each and every edge of the six extremities in the lower ones of the body.
